title: Cellular
hint.absent: No cellular modem was found. Check that ModemManager is running.
hint.noSim: Insert a SIM card to use mobile data.
hint.locked: The SIM needs its PIN. Unlock it with: mmcli -i any --pin=XXXX
hint.noService: The modem can't register with a carrier. A new SIM must be activated by your carrier first.
hint.denied: The carrier rejected this SIM. Check that it's activated and the plan includes data.
hint.registered: On the network but mobile data isn't connected.
